text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu conquered the Yushun Himba 
(Oaks). People were ecstatic over her 
overwhelming strength, raising 
expectations that she could claim the 
Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once summer training camp is over, the 
Shuka Sho is finally next. The two make 
preparations to ensure victory. Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A craving had begun to stir within the 
Trainer. A desire to keep watching Mejiro 
Ramonu run... even after her Triple Tiara 
challenge was over.
